name: divider
description: Dividers bring clarity to a layout by grouping and dividing content in close proximity. They can also be used to establish rhythm and hierarchy.

documentBlocks.content: Dividers bring clarity to a layout by grouping and dividing content in close proximity. They can also be used to establish rhythm and hierarchy.

Place a divider below a header.

Dividers (medium or large) can be used in combination with a header text to create a section or a page title. In such cases, place the divider below the header.

documentBlocks.dont: Dividers lose their value when overused. Use them sparingly to avoid creating unnecessary noise.
